status: user-defined decision criteria adopted after the current derived-target scores and before raw-lensing scoring

parameter_accounting.universal_gravity_settings: Constants or functional choices shared unchanged by every galaxy and cluster
parameter_accounting.object_specific_gravity_parameters: Halo, acceleration-scale, slip, or force-law parameters independently adjusted for an individual object
parameter_accounting.observational_nuisance_parameters: Distance, inclination, stellar mass-to-light, source position, and calibration quantities required by every theory and reported separately
parameter_accounting.measured_physical_inputs: Baryonic density, gas profile, morphology, and coherence measurements; inputs are not free gravity parameters when inferred without gravity residuals

beat_MOND_operational_gate.galaxy_parity: One unchanged candidate setting predicts galaxy rotation curves comparably to or better than fixed-a0 MOND under identical nuisance treatment
beat_MOND_operational_gate.cluster_lensing: The same unchanged candidate setting predicts raw cluster-lensing observables better than the fixed-a0 MOND comparator under frozen relativistic closures and the same covariance
beat_MOND_operational_gate.prohibited_shortcut: No separate cluster acceleration scale, lensing multiplier, or object-specific gravity parameter

beat_per_object_dark_matter_operational_.universality: The candidate uses zero object-specific gravity parameters across galaxies and clusters
beat_per_object_dark_matter_operational_.predictive_performance: The universal candidate matches or beats the declared per-object halo comparator on held-out galaxy and raw cluster-lensing observables
beat_per_object_dark_matter_operational_.complexity: Report global gravity settings, object-specific gravity parameters, and observational nuisances separately
beat_per_object_dark_matter_operational_.claim_boundary: Passing beats the tested per-object halo-fitting protocol, not every dark-matter model or Lambda-CDM
